storylines: CASEY: Next game — the Village People host the ASHL Blue Jackets this Tuesday, right here at home, Canlan Sports Winnipeg. We haven't seen this team yet this season, so we're going in fresh with no tape and no excuses. After a night like tonight, though? I'll take that matchup any day. GORD: Home ice, full roster hopefully, and something to build on. It's a start. Don't blow it. CASEY: Thanks for listening to Ice and Easy, the Village People Hockey Podcast. We'll see you Tuesday. GORD: Four goals each half, all sixty minutes. Let's try that.
